sloka: यश्चैष चापासिशरौघजुष्टं पताकिनं पावकदीप्तरूपम् ।रथं समास्थाय विभात्युदग्रो नरान्तको ऽसौ नगशृङ्गयोधी ।। ६.५९.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: yaścaiṣa cāpāsiśaraughajuṣṭaṁ patākinaṁ pāvakadīptarūpam ।rathaṁ samāsthāya vibhātyudagro narāntako 'sau nagaśṛṅgayodhī ।। 6.59.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Again, comes Naranthaka, with multitude of swords and arrows, mounted on top of a chariot with flags, blazing like fire, who fights with mountain peaks.
